author: Clement C. Moore, Robert Ingpen
video_title: 🎅🏼The Night Before Christmas 🎄 Kids Book Xmas Eve Short Read Aloud Rhyming Santa Claus Classic Poem
description:
A father is awakened on Christmas Eve, to witness his family's visit from St. Nicholas!

Mr. Paul reads aloud "The Night Before Christmas" by Clement C. Moore, illustrated by Robert Ingpen. This classic holiday poem is presented as a beautiful picture book, with inviting painted illustrations. Make it part of your family's Christmas Eve tradition! This short story book is perfect as a bedtime story on that special night, so filled with expectation, or at school just before the holiday break. It's perfect for preschool, kindergarten, first grade, and second grade. 

One thing I love about this version of the tale is that the illustrator Ingpen gives full consideration to the text, and renders Santa Claus as the poet describes him, "a jolly old elf." This is the first time I have encountered an artist who took that line literally, and it adds a new dimension to the whole story—the size of Santa's sleigh, the ease with which he comes down the chimney, his interaction with the narrator... all of it comes alive in a fresh way that makes perfect sense. I suspect Ingpen has met the real Santa Claus, and that's how he knew to paint him this way.

In this version, the hungry fox, rather than being an antagonist to our titular hero, becomes his friend and mentor as he figures out where he belongs in life.

This picture book is intended for students in the primary grades of kindergarten, first grade, and second grade. Third graders will also appreciate the story's humor and its central moral concept.
